data	git diff HEAD~1 > /tmp/lean-bench/out.diff
data	git show HEAD:README.md > /tmp/lean-bench/readme.md
data	cat README.md > /tmp/lean-bench/copy.md
data	grep -rn workflow scripts > /tmp/lean-bench/grep.txt
data	git diff HEAD~1 | wc -l
data	git log --oneline -5 | cut -c1-7
data	grep -rn workflow scripts | python3 -c 'import sys;print(len(sys.stdin.read()))'
data	git status --short | awk '{print $2}'
data	ls -la | sort
data	cat README.md | shasum
display	git status
display	git diff HEAD~1
